boundaries: MBES is the player/GM built-environment and settlement gameplay/orchestration layer; it does not replace canonical World, Environment, Character, Inventory, Economy, Project, Action/Event, Settlement or organization owners
MIB-14 retains vehicle/platform/base/facility definition and deterministic foundation authority; MBES composes those foundations into richer playable construction and settlement loops
MCS retains cartographic geometry, map/interior authoring and presentation authority; drawing or editing geometry never silently commits construction or World truth
MRCS retains rules/content-definition and blueprint/content-authoring authority; MBES executes or previews governed construction gameplay from accepted definitions
APW/D26 retains durable Project/task and campaign-time authority; construction labor, schedules and phases commit through owner-approved Project operations

MIB-12 retains crafting/transformation semantics, MIB-13 retains prices/trade/settlement, ICF retains cultivation/ingredient/production definitions, and CEL/APM retains Cozy orchestration/automation boundaries
ODL retains organization/business/base/settlement/faction/crew/family relationship seams and SCL retains strategic-scale formation/conflict/consequence authority
World, Environment, Reality/Branch and related owners define canonical gravity, atmosphere, climate, ecology, magic/technology laws, terrain/world state, sentience and world-response behavior

MBES may emit explicit construction/extraction/pollution/habitat/density/resource externality observations or proposals and consume owner-authorized World/Environment responses; it cannot invent canonical world reactions on its own

Owner-directed Oara requirement: Oara's planetary sentience responds to pollution and over-development; MBES must support this through generic reactive-world hooks rather than an Oara-only hard-coded rules path

different branches, realities, worlds and environments may impose different construction constraints, material behavior, utility assumptions, hazards, ecological carrying capacity and consequence profiles

construction-resolution levels remain distinct and may summarize or expand without duplicating canonical identity: settlement/district → site/parcel → structure → level/zone → space/room → component/fixture → connection/network

functional room/facility classification is capability-derived from accepted components, networks, access and environment conditions where owner rules support it; labels alone do not create capabilities
network automation is bounded condition→action orchestration over authorized owner operations and does not provide unrestricted scripting or autonomous GM/human decision authority
structural, utility, ecology and city simulation are game-rule simulations rather than real-world engineering/safety claims
optional AI remains advisory/presentation only and cannot silently place, demolish, spend, pollute, relocate residents, change ownership, publish or mutate canonical state
all reusable assets, blueprints, prefabs, imported models and derivatives preserve ARI identity, rights and provenance
no paid/cloud provider is required for blocking construction, simulation, validation, blueprint or settlement workflows
proprietary benchmark products are clean-room planning provenance only; protected source, assets, distinctive UI expression, maps, save formats and private protocols are not copied
no implementation authority until separately governed start
